column1: # Our adjudications of the rows that the dev-time checker (LemmInflect, a pip tool; nothing ships from it) disagrees with.
# Columns: spelling, lemma, part-of-speech letter, verdict (valid or invalid), note giving the reason, optional features.
# The verdict is ours. The older rows (notes that name AGID, a former source that has been removed from the project; the names are history) rest on
# OEWN, the Moby word list and our lists and rules. The newer rows (one-sentence notes, with a features column) are verdicts of the audit adjudicator
# (a language model that was shown our form and the checker's form, with controls; tools/forms-audit/audit_ingest.py), never of the checker itself;
# the evidence ends with the models and the confidences that decided the row ([gpt-6.1-sol high], or a medium verdict that a second model rechecked).
# The checker's own forms are not recorded here.
# A row the checker disagrees with and that is not listed stays an error. A row the checker accepts is valid whatever is listed.
# The rows that were judged wrong are not listed: they were corrected in the generator, in corpus/lexicon/form-corrections.tsv or in
# corpus/lexicon/forms-authored.tsv (the authored forms; the removal of a variant is noted in the evidence of its sidecar row).
# Adjudicated for the samples of seeds 20240601, 99, 7, 2025 and 31337 with 300 rows per stratum.
